description: One short answer to 'what does X cost right now?': the best current list price for a model, GPU or VPS plan named in words ('claude opus', 'gpt-5 mini', 'H100', 'hetzner cx22'), from the provider's own page or API first. Returns one `answer` sentence (name, price, unit, read date, source), the one `best` row and at most two `alternatives`, a few hundred bytes in all. Use this first; use search_skus for the full list, cheapest_for_spec to rank by a minimum spec, get_price for every price point of one SKU. Returns an error object when nothing matches, with near matches.

category.description: vps, gpu or llm; omit to search all
